name: What should I consider when choosing a new sliding door handle for my home in South San Francisco?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a new sliding door handle for my home in South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a new sliding door handle for your South San Francisco home, consider security features like key locks versus basic latches, the handle's durability and material (especially important for coastal weather resistance), and its aesthetic appeal to match your home's style. Also, ensure the new handle's dimensions and screw spacing are compatible with your existing door. We can assess your door and provide recommendations for the best option that meets both your functional and aesthetic needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider security, durability (for coastal weather), aesthetics, and compatibility with your existing door's dimensions when choosing a new handle.
